title: Register a service in the service catalogue
summary: Add a new service to the service catalogue with its owner team, tier and on-call contact, so that it gets a service id that namespaces, dashboards and access groups are named after.

resources.title: catalog-info.yaml reference
resources.description: Every field of the catalogue file, with examples.

prerequisites.title: The tier of the service
prerequisites.description: Agree it with your product owner using the tier descriptions in the portal.

actors.name: You
actors.description: An engineer of the team that will own the service.

steps.title: Add catalog-info.yaml to the repository
instructions: Create catalog-info.yaml in the root of the repository.
Fill in name, description, owner team, tier and lifecycle 'experimental'.

steps.title: Register the repository in the portal
instructions: Open the developer portal and press 'Register existing component'.
Paste the link to catalog-info.yaml and press 'Import'.

steps.title: Create the catalogue entry and service id
Check the entry and note the service id
instructions: Search the portal for your service.
Check owner team and tier are right.
Copy the service id; the next processes ask for it.
